### Use case and observed need

What are you trying to do? Describe a concrete limitation and who it affects.
The integration uses monthly billing data; other white-label portals are not
verified, and MFA is currently unsupported.

### Desired outcome

What observable behavior would solve the problem? Give a small example and how
you would check that it works.

### Alternatives

What existing options or workarounds have you considered, and what is missing?

### Evidence (if available)

Link relevant public documentation or describe a synthetic example. Distinguish
observed behavior from assumptions; omit private resident data and real payloads.
